On this small beans plot, I will keep costs low because my land is very small and I cannot spend much on inputs. For beans, I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer, but if I have some manure or compost at home I will put a little to help the soil. I will plant improved seed if I can get it, because it can give better yield on a small plot, and I will manage mostly with family labor. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will only use chemicals if there is a serious problem, so for now I am not planning pesticide or herbicide.
